name: Wrathful Dinosaur
description: This figurine of a charging triceratops was crafted from the dinosaur's femur and contains its spirit.
disable: DC 24 Nature check (expert) to banish the dinosaur's spirit with a primal incantation, DC 28 Intimidation check to scare it off with a frightening display, or DC 26 Survival check (expert) to calm the spirit

offensiveAbilities.name: Triceratops Trample
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A living creature approaches within 10 feet of the figurine

Effect A spectral triceratops appears around the figurine and charges toward the triggering creature, affecting a line 30 feet long. Creatures in this area take 4d10+22 bludgeoning damage (DC 26 basic Reflex save).
